title: SuperPipeline attention.pending
description: A card has come to rest on a person for a reason that is neither a question nor a review (charter: waiting cards and broker approvals reach chat §1-2). Pushed when the card parks, and read back by the carrier's sweep from GET /v1/boards/:id/attention/pending, from one builder. Mirrors SuperPipeline's AttentionPendingBody (apps/api/src/board/views.ts). It has no subject: nothing is frozen, so nothing is bound. Readers ignore properties they do not know.

boardId.description: Null only on a board not yet initialised; a carrier needs it to route the event.

boardName.description: Empty string when the board has no name, never absent.

stageName.description: The stage's name, or its key when the board no longer has that stage.

waitId.description: Names this wait. A card that parks again is a new wait; an answer naming an ended one is refused.

detail.description: The run's own words; null when the park gave none.

failureCount.description: How many attempts failed, when the breaker tripped; null otherwise.

earlierStages.description: The stages before this one, in order.

options.description: resume_here (approve), one resume_at:<stageKey> (choose) per earlier stage, archive (reject).

ts.description: When the card came to rest.

input.description: What choosing the option asks the person to type.

deadline.description: When the decision is reminded about and escalated. Absent when its stage sets no timeout.
